Chapter 1253: Chapter 12: Six Ancient Countries, Under the Progenitor, I Call the Shots (Request Subscription)

Lin Yuan is ultimately not a Thirteenth Layer Time Life.

Even with the power of the Sky Void Tripod, the future images he saw were extremely fragmented.

And without any context.

But from the conclusions derived from that image, it can be speculated that his future self is likely to have a deep enmity with some special place.

To the extent that he would give up everything in the Chaos Void to destroy the opponent.

And currently, with Lin Yuan’s strength, even if the spirit of the special place takes action, it is impossible to do anything to him.

No such enmity exists.

It’s even more impossible that he would destroy everything just to ruin the opponent.

"The future....."

Lin Yuan’s expression was thoughtful.

The future is ever-changing, and every time node will give birth to countless future timelines.

The future image he saw was merely one possibility, not a predetermined future.

Moreover, since Lin Yuan was on guard, this future is unlikely to occur.

...

Fang Yuan World, Fierce Sun Capital.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, observing the continuously pulsating ’Abyss Dragon’s Heart’ in front of him.

"Perfect, too perfect."

The more Lin Yuan observed, the more amazed he became. The power system and basic structure of the ’Abyss Dragon’ completely surpassed Lin Yuan’s previous understanding of life.

At first, Lin Yuan thought that the foundation of a Chaos Void cultivator would surely be stronger than that of this Fang Yuan World, but for the Abyss Dragon, the strongest aspect is its own foundation.

Every particle of the Abyss Dragon’s body contains a vast world, and its heart even nurtures a miniature Fang Yuan World.

Such a foundation, such profoundness, even Lin Yuan, who is currently cultivating the ’Infinite Void’, may not necessarily compare.

"If I could ’imitate’ the Abyss Dragon and open up a ’universe’ within each of my own particles, then reconstruct with the ’Infinite Void’, my power..."

Lin Yuan’s heart was greatly moved.

Twelve Layers stepping into Thirteen Layers, the nature of life will make a significant leap, transforming into Time Life.

However, even among Time Lives, there are differences in strength. The deeper the accumulation at the Twelve Layer level, the greater the power increase upon stepping into the Thirteenth Layer.

Why did the Da Fu Ancestor immediately take action against the ’Abyss Dragon’ upon stepping into the Thirteenth Layer?

It was because dragging it out would allow the ’Abyss Dragon’ the possibility of entering the Thirteenth Layer.

And with the Abyss Dragon’s foundation, once it stepped into the Thirteenth Layer, its power would probably surpass the Da Fu Ancestor.

"Let’s try it."

Lin Yuan began to further observe the Abyss Dragon’s Heart.

...

Golden Mist Treasure Land.

Lin Yuan focused most of his mind on understanding the operation of the Origin Source of Fang Yuan World.

The remainder of his mind was trying to sort out his own causality.

"Ever since the Martial Arts Evolution Road spread completely among the six Ancient Countries, my karma has become infinitely more complex."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The reason for this lies in the fact that every Martial Tao cultivator is equivalent to forming a causal relationship with him, the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

Even due to the dominance relationship of the Evolution Road, Lin Yuan can follow these causal relationships to observe every detail of each Martial Tao cultivator’s life.

"When Martial Tao is initially passed down, it’s necessary to take in some disciples with Martial Talent for cultivation."

Lin Yuan contemplated, noting this approach has two purposes: one is to better spread Martial Tao, at least let the beings of this Fang Yuan World see that Lin Yuan is sincerely propagating Martial Tao.

The second is preparation for opening up the Seventh Ancient Country in the future.

The establishment of an Ancient Country certainly requires a large number of subordinates to manage it.

Lin Yuan himself can’t possibly handle everything personally?

Compared to other ancestors with numerous offspring, Lin Yuan’s rise was too fast, and he still has no offspring, in this case, he can completely use disciples as a substitute.

The advantage of disciples is that they are not limited by bloodline and can absorb any gifted beings.

As long as they practice Martial Tao, they are all Lin Yuan’s disciples.

"Let me see..."

Lin Yuan began manipulating the lines of causality, and by following these connections, he could see the state of each Martial Tao cultivator, thus judging their talent in Martial Tao cultivation.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan had barely started watching when he was pleasantly surprised.

"Martial Arts Time Talent?"

Lin Yuan’s expression showed a hint of intrigue. From the Second Layer onward, Martial Tao requires insight into the corresponding power.

For instance, what Lin Yuan comprehended was the Yin Yang Taiji Power, which evolved into today’s Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao.

And at this moment, Lin Yuan discovered a cultivator with Martial Arts Time Talent.

If one follows this path, they will eventually condense a Martial Arts Time Primordial Spirit and further evolve a Time Great Dao. The potential is absolutely the greatest Lin Yuan has seen so far among beings with Martial Tao cultivation talent.

"Is it in the Thousand Teeth Domain of the Da Ling Ancient Country?"

Lin Yuan followed the Causal Sensing, confirming the specific location of the person, "Named ’Meng Shi’?"

"Such a great Martial Tao prodigy should definitely be brought over."

With a slight thought, Lin Yuan conjured an avatar in the Da Ling Ancient Country and headed towards the Thousand Teeth Domain.

...

Da Ling Ancient Country, Thousand Teeth Domain.

A pale-faced young man was desperately fleeing, with several auras swiftly closing in behind, clearly intent on killing him.

"I can’t stay in the Thousand Teeth Domain any longer, or I’ll eventually be drained to death by the Thousand Teeth King."

The young man gritted his teeth. In the Ancient Country of Da Ling, the cultivation focused on the ’spirit’ of life, thus many powerful figures of the ancient country typically enjoyed influencing, controlling, or even absorbing the ’spirit’ of all beings to nourish themselves.

The young man greatly disliked this cultivation method. In his view, every life was an independent entity, and their ’spirit’ belonged to themselves. How could it be wantonly manipulated, controlled, or even absorbed?

"Not long ago, the Martial Tao established by the Galaxy Venerate spread to the Thousand Teeth Domain. I practiced it a bit, and it suited me well. Even if I leave the Thousand Teeth Domain, leave the Ancient Country of Da Ling, and abandon its cultivation heritage, I can still survive and grow stronger."

The young man’s thoughts turned rapidly. The ruler of the Thousand Teeth Domain, the Thousand Teeth King, was a Heavenly Venerate with terrifying power, viewing all beings within the Thousand Teeth Domain as mere resources, selecting a batch of lives for devouring and absorption at regular intervals.

Of course, to ensure ongoing development, the Thousand Teeth King wouldn’t consume everything completely, but only part. The young man had been chosen several times and felt that if he stayed any longer, he’d eventually be drained into a dried husk by the Thousand Teeth King.

"Run, run, run!"

The young man sped up as much as possible. He had to get out quickly.

If he lingered too long, the number of pursuers would increase, possibly even drawing the attention of Great Lord-level powerhouses.

The Thousand Teeth King had a strong possessiveness over the lives in the domain, forbidding them to escape. His Great Lord subordinates would dispatch several sentries to prevent beings like the young man from escaping.

Just at this moment.

A silent figure appeared in the direction the young man was fleeing.

The young man’s pupils contracted, wanting to dodge, but found his body suddenly immobilized.

"What is this?"

His heart chilled, immediately realizing that the figure before him was an existence he couldn’t contend with.

"One of the Thousand Teeth King’s subordinates?"

His mind trembled, contemplating ending his own life directly. Those like him who escaped and were caught were sure to suffer agonies worse than death.

"Don’t be hasty."

Lin Yuan smiled as he looked at the young man, "I don’t know the Thousand Teeth King."

Before coming, Lin Yuan had already understood the situation in the Thousand Teeth Domain. In fact, the entire Ancient Country of Da Ling was the same. Due to the ’spirit’ of life, the hierarchy from top to bottom was extremely strict.

The weak must offer their ’spirit’ to the strong, and the strong must offer to the even stronger, repeating this cycle, with the royal family of the Ancient Country of Da Ling ultimately benefiting.

This was also why the Ancient Country of Da Ling was among the six great ancient countries, second only to the Ancient Country of Da Fu, because of this unique cultivation system.

Lin Yuan did not agree with this cultivation system but wasn’t overly opposed to it either; it’s just a method of cultivation.

"You don’t know the Thousand Teeth King?"

The young man sighed with relief in his heart.

That’s a relief.

"Your name is Meng Shi?"

Lin Yuan looked at the young man and asked casually.

"How did you know, senior?"

The young man Meng Shi was slightly taken aback, curiously asking.

"When I want to know something, I naturally know." Lin Yuan replied with a smile.

"Yes."

Although young Meng Shi couldn’t understand, he nodded obediently.

He realized at this moment that the Lin Yuan before him must be a powerful figure just passing by, likely not a cultivator of the Ancient Country of Da Ling.

"Alright, let’s get to the main point." Lin Yuan looked at the young man, confirming the Martial Arts Time talent in him, and directly said, "I intend to take you as a disciple. What do you think?"

"Take me as a disciple?"

The young man Meng Shi was slightly stunned.

"What? Unwilling?"

Lin Yuan asked.

"Willing, of course I’m willing."

The young man Meng Shi immediately nodded.

He could be sure that Lin Yuan was definitely a powerhouse far beyond him, and to be taken as a disciple by such an existence was undoubtedly a great opportunity.

But...

"Senior, I will be honest with you."

The young man Meng Shi said, "Taking me as a disciple might bring you trouble."

"I’ve been selected by the Thousand Teeth King. At intervals, I must offer my own ’spirit’. I refused, so I ran away."

The young man Meng Shi looked at Lin Yuan, "I’m currently being chased by the Thousand Teeth King’s subordinates. Taking me as a disciple would mean offending the Thousand Teeth King, and the Thousand Teeth King is the Da Ling Venerable. Offending him..."

The young man Meng Shi had thought of agreeing to Lin Yuan’s mentorship offer, then escaping the Thousand Teeth Domain with him.

But, doing so, if discovered, would surely implicate Lin Yuan, and the young man Meng Shi didn’t want to do that.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded, continuing, "You just need to answer whether you are willing or not."

"Senior, I’m definitely willing, but this is the Thousand Teeth Domain, the Ancient Country of Da Ling. The Thousand Teeth King has many followers. Taking me as a disciple, I’m very grateful, but the consequences would be severe..."

The young man Meng Shi’s tone became urgent, faintly sensing that the pursuers were rapidly closing in.

"Senior, the Ancient Country of Da Ling is unlike other ancient countries; it greatly restricts us. This is the rule of the Ancient Country of Da Ling. Senior, you should leave quickly." After finishing, the young man Meng Shi intended to change direction and flee.

But he found his body still immobilized, and couldn’t help but look at Lin Yuan in confusion, "Senior?"

"Rules?"

Lin Yuan looked towards the capital of Da Ling, pausing his speech for a moment, and then smiled, "Among the six great ancient countries, below the Ancestor, many matters are up to me."

"What I say is the rule."

After Lin Yuan finished speaking, he lifted his right hand and gently made a gesture. The Thousand Teeth King, far away in the Thousand Teeth City, appeared before him in an instant.

Lin Yuan glanced at the Thousand Teeth King, whose face showed terror, "What do you say?"
